operating_point_semantics: Training-score upper-tail quantile operating points (99.5th, 99th, 98th percentiles / nominal 0.5%, 1%, 2% training alert rates) frozen before validation; not validated detection accuracy, expected future alert rates, or proof of true anomalies.

phase3a_configuration.timestamp_semantics: Ordered, timezone-naive source hourly index; no local-clock interpretation.

weather_validation.source_fields: Retained as source values; no imputation.
